name: soft-key-door-goal
task: Pick up the key, then open the door, and then, ideally, walk onto the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard steps are picking up the key and opening the door. Existence(door_open) hard makes the door open; Precedence(has_key, door_open) hard forces has_key, so no Existence(has_key) is needed. The goal is only preferred ('ideally'), so Existence(at_goal) is soft and forces nothing, and the hard Precedence(door_open, at_goal) keeps the stated order; door_open is thus the last hard step and its hard Existence is correct, with has_key forced by the Precedence chain.
